      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "simplify the test to not mine to the end of the difficulty period since the edge case works at any height",

      "status": "agreed_to_disagree",
      "status_note": "author preferred testing retarget boundary heights for documentation; reviewer noted regtest mining is cheap enough and not a blocker",

        "rc:4005190658",
        "rc:4012991563"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4007699285",
      "status_by_quote": "I would have prefered that the test had been simplified to be more focussed on the edge case only and with mining only 6 blocks. But regtest mining is cheap enough that this isn't a blocker for me and maybe there is some value in the added documentation here."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5595738656",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "move test to mining_basic.py next to timewarp and murch-zawy tests rather than in interface_ipc_mining.py",
      "quote": "This test seems to belong in mining_basic.py, not here, it sits right next to `test_timewarp()` and `test_murch_zawy_mintime()`.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author explained testing IPC failure mode; reviewer confirmed not a blocker",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6309997324",
        "c:6311715297"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:6311023867"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6311023867",
      "status_by_quote": "It's fine to use one stone to kill two birds here, but we don't have to use it as a reason to add the test where it doesn't belong (Not a blocker as well)."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5595738656",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "reduce the test to a single boundary case instead of three rounds to reduce test runtime",
      "quote": "I'd also prefer this to just be a single test at any one boundary. The subtest currently runs ~3s; making it a single case drops it to ~1s.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "reviewer noted ignoring the suggestion is not a blocker, author left code as-is",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6309997324",
        "c:6311715297"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:6311023867"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6311023867",
      "status_by_quote": "feel free to push, will reACK or ignore not a blocker."
    },
    {
      "id": "r:5595738656",
      "part": 3,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "reduce block count by testing sequentially using invalidateblock rather than mining from scratch",
      "quote": "We could also reduce the number of blocks generated by making it a linear test",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "accepted",
      "status_note": "author replied invalidateblock adds complexity; reviewer agreed it is not ideal and was just surfacing the idea",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6309997324"
      ],
      "other_replies": [
        "c:6311023867"
      ],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6311023867",
      "status_by_quote": "Yeah, not ideal, just surfacing the idea."
    }
  ],
  "support": [

      "id": "r:5200714481",
      "verdict": "ACK",
      "reason": "Thanks for addressing my feedback!",

        "test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py",

      ]
    }
  ],
  "notes": "Reclassified fjahr's test simplification suggestion from objection to suggestion under updated rules. Added ismaelsadeeq's review ACK along with their suggestions regarding test location, runtime, and block invalidation, all of which were treated as non-blocking and dropped.",

    }
  ]
